_readme: The format bank for AI video production: every format the video machine runs, one row each. A run's `format` (run.json) must equal a row's `id` or the run is refused (RUN-PROTOCOL.md, Intake). A row is a PROFILE — how a piece of this shape is built: what a scene contains, the beat shape, the stations, the references. It is the TEMPLATE layer in components/naming/FORMATS.md, addressed `format:video:format-profile:<id>` (components/naming/names.py format_ref). Profiles say what a scene contains; they never carry gates — RUN-PROTOCOL.md does. A new format: copy TEMPLATE.md, fill it, add the row here as `draft`, run `python3 formats/render_bank.py`. Only the owner signs a row `approved`.
scope: AI-video PRODUCTION profiles only — how the machine builds a piece of a given shape. NOT the 50 organic-video structures (components/swipe-organic/formats.json — what a swiped post's structure is), not the copy styles, not the image build templates, not the email design formats. Map: components/naming/FORMATS.md

status_values.draft: written, not signed — may run, and the run is the evidence for signing
status_values.approved: the owner signed it; the profile is the standard for this shape
status_values.deprecated: kept for the record; a run may not name it

formats.name: Song ad
formats.what: one lyric line, illustrated; shot length = line spacing; the product late and small
formats.proven_on: 2026-09-03 (fal) and 2026-09-04 (Higgsfield) — the calls are the provider pages; 2026-09-16 again on Higgsfield, record not in the repo; filed: runs/video-production/brand-b/resilia-song-160986941 (2026-09-16, Higgsfield)
formats.notes: the first format run end to end; its two runs became archive/fal.md and archive/higgsfield.md

formats.name: Single presenter
formats.what: one person to camera, one line, one of several locations
formats.proven_on: 2026-09-16 on Higgsfield with a demonstration beat inside it — runs/video-production/brand-b/smo-06-final-287-bottles
formats.notes: the UGC shape — the workhorse; profile written 2026-09-02, not yet run end to end on this machine

formats.name: Meme
formats.what: one swiped meme beat — the source's decisive action kept unchanged; the caption added at the edit
formats.proven_on: 2026-09-16 on Higgsfield — record not in the repo (chat sandbox); profile drafted from the session's reports, for the owner to correct
formats.notes: the source's scroll-stopper is the whole format; a softened action is a failed piece — the 16 Sep pack holds no record of this piece; kzn03 and competitor-a-06 are not it

formats.name: Expert consultation
formats.what: one presenter takes the same problem to several experts in turn; the price of each answer is the argument, the product is the last expert
formats.notes: the owner 2026-09-17: the storytelling piece with Keri is this format, and expert-consult is its name. Was two draft rows; now one.

formats.name: Demonstration
formats.what: the product doing the work — hands, surfaces, before and after; an action is one beat
formats.notes: profile written 2026-09-02, not yet run end to end on this machine

formats.name: Micro-drama
formats.what: several characters in one continuous set — a confrontation, a turn, an offer
formats.notes: the method was first proven on this shape (2026-09-01 production); no piece has run this machine's route end to end

formats.name: Testimonial montage
formats.what: one person, one line, one room, many times over — the accumulation is the argument
formats.notes: profile written 2026-09-02, not yet run end to end on this machine

formats.name: Remedy
formats.what: what people used to put on it at home — the kitchen, the jar, the older hands — then today's version: the product; one step said is one step shown
formats.proven_on: 2026-10-20 — Grandma Yai remedy reels (egg white pore peel, cold tea eye bundles, cracked heels) on the reel line; swipe @mayalin_wellness
formats.notes: first organic format run end to end; organic and paid are the same video, only the ask differs (RUN-PROTOCOL.md, one machine)

formats.name: Comedy skit
formats.what: a character played big in a real-looking world, every line answered by a reaction, ending on a flip
formats.notes: the owner 2026-10-23: comedy skits operate similarly; first run the pastor barber body
